{{Quote|Bounty was put in second party by Tien Wallub, which is not uncommon. Tien works at the cantina and makes these second party posts all the time, he is listed as the contact.|[[Stren Colo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:I" />}}
'''Tien Wallub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who lived on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wallub worked in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="SWG:I" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] by the name [[Jessk]] was catch cheating at [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with other customers, including with a friend of the cantina's owner. The owner then decided to take it upon himself to solve the problem and tasked Tien Wallub to place a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Jessk. The bounty was addressed to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Bounty [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Stren Colo]] and the Trandoshan was forced to flee Kashyyyk.<ref name="SWG:I" /> Jessk was eventually shot down by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:JtT">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Jessk the Trandoshan|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tien Wallub appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:I" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tien Wallub was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:I" />
